title: ADMIN REPAIR TABLE can publish index metadata that does not match reused physical index data

payload.p_check: a repaired TableInfo reuses the old table/index IDs and physical index data
payload.q_claim: the user-supplied CREATE TABLE definition describes that reused physical index exactly
payload.fault: ADMIN REPAIR TABLE changes index PrefixLen or Unique while preserving the old index ID
payload.oracle: table-scan versus FORCE INDEX differential, default-plan result set, duplicate-constraint behavior, and ADMIN CHECK TABLE
controls: same physical prefix repaired with same prefix GREEN
physical KEY repaired as UNIQUE RED
physical UNIQUE repaired as KEY RED
payload.contract_gate: confirm whether ADMIN REPAIR TABLE must reject any index option mismatch or requires an externally exact definition

name: Repair metadata must reconcile with reused physical index data

payload.description: Find recovery or metadata-repair code that reuses a physical object ID while accepting a reconstructed logical definition.
positive_signal: new logical metadata is built from operator or external input
validation compares identity/name but not encoding or constraint options
planner or writer trusts the new metadata without rebuilding the object
required_gates: table scan versus forced index rowset differential
default planner choice observed after repair
future write tested against published constraint
ADMIN CHECK TABLE treated as weak until proven to cover metadata equivalence
stop_rules: do not file until the operator-repair contract is explicit
do not count reverse option mismatch as a new root
retire if repair always rebuilds or validates physical encoding

provenance.source: ADMIN REPAIR TABLE live RED/GREEN on testbed 8220955

name: DDL ADMIN REPAIR TABLE metadata reconstruction surface

state_model: repair mode hides or exposes a selected table through RepairInfo
RepairTable builds a new TableInfo from CREATE TABLE input
table ID, column IDs, index IDs, and auto-increment state are selectively copied from old metadata
existing physical index data is reused because the index ID is preserved
planner and write paths consume the repaired TableInfo
harness_capabilities: failpoint-enabled testbed owner with repair mode and repair table list
pre-existing table with controlled index prefix/uniqueness
ADMIN REPAIR TABLE exact and mismatched definitions

name: Reconstruct a damaged table with an existing physical index

setup: create a stable table with a secondary index and known rowset
preserve the physical table/index while simulating a metadata-repair entry
run ADMIN REPAIR TABLE with an exact or one-dimension-mismatched CREATE TABLE
payload.strong_oracle: compare IGNORE INDEX, FORCE INDEX, default plan, duplicate writes, and ADMIN CHECK TABLE
payload.contract_gate: the operator-recovery contract must say whether incompatible definitions are rejected or operator-supplied exactness is assumed

name: Repair exact definition then one-dimension index mismatch

steps: create the physical table and collect a table-scan reference rowset
repair with the exact physical index definition and verify the GREEN control
restart or enter the repair harness with a selected table
repair with one changed PrefixLen or Unique option while preserving name/columns
run table scan, forced index scan, default plan, future duplicate write, and ADMIN CHECK TABLE
invalid_if: the repair operation rebuilds the index
the selected table is not in the actual repair path
the post-repair query does not use the repaired index
expected_observations: GREEN exact definition has identical rowsets
RED mismatch publishes metadata but changes rowset or constraint behavior

name: A repaired index definition must match the reused physical index data

payload.p_check: RepairTable preserves the old table/index IDs and does not rebuild the existing index
payload.q_claim: published PrefixLen, Unique, and related index options are the same as the physical index encoding and constraint semantics
payload.failure_consequence: wrong index lookup results or a published uniqueness contract that storage does not enforce

name: Repaired index metadata agrees with table-scan and constraint behavior

payload.tier2: IGNORE INDEX versus FORCE INDEX point lookup and default EXPLAIN plan
payload.tier3: insert duplicate according to published UNIQUE metadata plus ADMIN CHECK TABLE
payload.red: published metadata mismatch causes rowset divergence or unique Point_Get drops existing rows
payload.green: exact physical prefix/uniqueness control returns identical rowsets and ADMIN CHECK TABLE is silent

name: ADMIN REPAIR TABLE changes reused index PrefixLen or Unique

payload.prefix_shape: physical KEY idx_v(v(3)) repaired as KEY idx_v(v(2))
payload.unique_shape: physical KEY idx_v(v) repaired as UNIQUE KEY idx_v(v), and physical UNIQUE KEY repaired as KEY
payload.injection: operator-supplied CREATE TABLE definition; no storage fault or data mutation failpoint

environment.shape: physical KEY idx_v(v(3)) repaired as the same KEY idx_v(v(3))

observed: table scan and FORCE INDEX both returned id=2 for abc-two

lessons.boundary: exact definition is a required control; repair success alone is not an oracle

environment.shape: physical KEY idx_v(v(3)) repaired as KEY idx_v(v(2))

observed: IGNORE INDEX found id=2 for abc-two
FORCE INDEX returned no row for abc-two

lessons.root_accounting: new repair-table fix locus; distinct from ADD INDEX downscale and FLASHBACK FK identity drift
lessons.quality: high consequence wrong-result candidate pending operator-repair contract confirmation

environment.shape: physical KEY idx_v(v) repaired as UNIQUE KEY idx_v(v)

observed: default Point_Get and FORCE INDEX returned only id=4

lessons.proof_break: logical uniqueness metadata is trusted by planner while reused physical data does not satisfy it
lessons.user_symptom: ordinary equality query silently returns one of several existing rows

environment.shape: physical UNIQUE KEY uk_v(v) repaired as KEY uk_v(v)

observed: duplicate values could be inserted after repair

lessons.proof_break: logical uniqueness constraint is weakened without rebuilding or validating the reused physical index
lessons.quality: same root and stronger constraint-blast-radius sibling, not a separate root
